title: Hamster eating a snack
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="30" ry="24" fill="#e8b06a"/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="18" ry="14" fill="#f7d9a8"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="24" fill="#e8b06a"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="24" r="8" fill="#e8b06a"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="24" r="4" fill="#f2a0a0"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="24" r="8" fill="#e8b06a"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="24" r="4" fill="#f2a0a0"/>
  <!-- cheek pouches -->
  <ellipse cx="31" cy="50" rx="10" ry="8" fill="#f7d9a8"/>
  <ellipse cx="69" cy="50" rx="10" ry="8" fill="#f7d9a8"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="40" r="4" fill="#3a2a5a"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="40" r="4" fill="#3a2a5a"/>
  <circle cx="42.2" cy="38.8" r="1.4" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="60.2" cy="38.8" r="1.4" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="3" ry="2.4" fill="#c96a6a"/>
  <!-- snack (sunflower seed) -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#6b4a2a" transform="rotate(-15 50 60)"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="4.5" ry="2.8" fill="#b98a4a" transform="rotate(-15 50 60)"/>
  <!-- little paws holding snack -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="62" r="4.5" fill="#f2c98e"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="62" r="4.5" fill="#f2c98e"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="90" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#f2c98e"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="90" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#f2c98e"/>
</svg>
